subtopic: Impact of Ongoing Fees on Long-Term Returns
source_evidence: These fees may seem small, but over time they can have a major impact on your investment portfolio. At the end of 20 years, the portfolio would be worth approximately $208,000. At the end of 20 years, the portfolio would be worth approximately $179,000.
question: Misconception: A small difference in annual fees will not make much difference to an investment over the long term.
answer: Even a seemingly small annual fee can have a major impact over time. In the source’s hypothetical example, a $100,000 investment growing 4% annually for 20 years is worth approximately $208,000 with a 0.25% annual fee, compared with approximately $179,000 with a 1.00% annual fee.
